title: Expansion of the source injective direct-image transport
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a morphism of schemes, $K\in D^+(\operatorname{Ab}(X_{et}))$, $J$ a bounded-below complex of injective abelian etale sheaves, and $q:K\cong QJ$. Write $H$ for the homotopy class of $J$ and $q^\prime:K\cong Q_hH$ for the lift through the fully faithful inclusion. The inverse of the canonical source direct-image comparison [def-weil-pbc-strict-local-injective-source-comparison] is the image under the inclusion of the derived direct-image unit at $H$, followed by the image of $R^+f_*(q^{\prime -1})$.

proof.text:
the defining isomorphism is the image of the direct-image transport by
q', followed by the inverse derived unit, then the homotopy and complex
localization comparisons. Inverting reverses these factors. The inverse of the
inverse unit is the unit itself. The homotopy functor comparison at a quotient
complex is the identity, as is quotientCompQhIso at that complex. Functoriality
and the identity laws therefore leave exactly the unit followed by transport
by q'.inv. Only source injectivity is used to define the original isomorphism;
no inverse image or target direct-image unit appears.
